tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs lū yi pa'i lugs bde chen 'jug ngogs bzhugs/

oṃ swa s+t+wi/ bde chen srid zhi kun gyi khyab bdag ni/ /'gyur bral rdo rje bzhi yi rnam rol gyis/ mkha' mnyam srid 'dir nam yang dag pa'i rgyun/ /rtag tu spro mdzad zung 'jug de la 'dud/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje slob dpon la/ /dngos po kun gyis lan brgyar phyag 'tshal nas/ /rtags pa'i rim pa las kyang gdod ma'i tshul/ /mngon du byed pa'i thabs 'di 'chad par 'dod/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug 'bum gyis legs btud pa/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug lū yi'i bzhed don gang*/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug sgrub pa'i thabs bzang po/ /rig sngags dbang phyug rnams kyis brten par 'os/ /dang por snang ba thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rjer shes pas/ dbang bskur ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas te khrus bya/ de nas rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'i thog mar/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa dang yi ge brgya pas rgyud sbyang ba rnams bya ste/ de yang 'di skad ces/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ / zhes lan bdun la sogs pa bya/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/

sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du lam zab mo bsgom par bgyi'o/ / lan gsum/ kye ma sems can sdug bsngal zhing*/ /kun rtog la ni mngon par zhen/ /de yi rtog pa gzhom phyir bdag /dpal ldan he ru ka sgom bya/ / gzhan yang spro na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi tshigs bcad ci rigs pa brjod par bya'o/ / rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gi bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsir spyan drangs nas hūṃ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa mā ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ ḍi ḍho me bhā wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhiṃ me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shre yaṃ ku ru hūṃ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wān badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa he ru ko bha wa mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūṃ phaṭa/ zhes ci nus su bzlas pa'i mthar/ mgon po/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyobs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/

/ thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ rdor sems yab yum rang la thim par bsgom mo/ /rnal 'byor dngos la dbye na/ mnyam gzhag dang*/ mnyam langs gnyis so/ /nga po la dgu ste/ gnas sam gzhi'i rnal 'byor/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor/ 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor/ byin gyis brlab pa'i rnal 'byor/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor/ mchod pa'i rnal 'byor/ nye bar bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po la/ rang bzhin gyi gzhi dang lam gyi gzhi gnyis so/ /dang po ni dam rdzas kyi ril bu khar bcug pa'am/ nang mchod byin gyis rlabs nas lce la bzhag cing*/ mi bzad pa'i dur khrod chen po'i dbus su mi ro'i gdan la 'dug par bsam nas/ 'di skad ces/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /yid dag pa'o/ / rang skad cig gis 'khor lo bde mchog zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pa can du gyur/ bdag nyid dpal he ru ka ste sems can thams cad la phan par bya'o/ /shrī he ru ko3 haṃ/ lan gsum/ lus dag pa'o/ /oṃ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ lte bar 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa'i ā li g.yas bskor dang kā l̥ g.yon bskor du lan gsum gyis bskor nas gnas pa las/ 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ā l̥ las spros pa rnams sna bug g.yas dang*/ kā l̥ las spros pa rnams g.yon nas mthon te/

bgegs kyi tshogs rnams bcom/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ slar yang lte ba'i sngags 'phreng la thim/ ngag dag pa'o/ /lus ngag yid gsum dag pas/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tu 'gro ba'i phyir/ gzhung las/ dang por re zhig rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi /zhes gsungs pas 'di bstan par lwa ba'i zhabs kyis bshad do/ /lam gyi gzhi la tshangs pa'i gnas gzhi sgom pa/ phung khams lhar dag pa/ srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa/ sbyor ba tshogs gnyis bsags pa ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig gnyis pa ni/ gzugs kyi phung po la rnam par snang mdzad do/ /tshor ba'i phung po la rdo rje nyi ma 'o/ /'du shes kyi phung po la pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go /'du byed kyi phung po la rdo rje rgyal po'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i phung po la rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid ni shrī he ru ka rdo rje'o/ /mig gnyis la gti mug rdo rje'o/ /rna ba gnyis la zhe sdang rdo rje'o/ /sna la phrag dog rdo rje'o/ /lce la 'dod chags rdo rje'o/ /lus la ser sna rdo rje'o/ /skye mched thams cad la dbang phyug rdo rje'o/ /sa'i khams la ltung byed ma'o/ /chu'i khams la gsod byed ma'o/ /me'i khams la 'gugs byed ma'o/ /rlung gi khams la pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma'o/ /nam mkha'i khams la pad+ma dra ba can no/ /de thams cad kyang stong nyid ye shes rdo rje don dam pa'i lha'i bdag nyid do/ / zhes brjod/ bsdu na de tsam gyis chog ste/ nga rgyal la slab pa'o/ /rgyas pa la mos na rnam pa la slab par bya ste/ /snga ma'i rjes thogs nyid du 'di skad ces/ mgo bor gzugs phung bh+ruṃ yig las/

/rnam snang dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ /lte bar tshor phung aṃ rdo rje/ /nyi ma ser po g.yas rin chen/ /mgrin par 'du shes hrīḥdamar po/ /pad+ma gar dbang g.yas pad+ma/ /long bur 'du byed hā ljang khu/ /rgyal po sna tshogs rdo rje g.yas/ /snying gar rnam shes hūṃ dkar las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje g.yas/ /phung po lnga ni ro mnyam pa/ /spyi gtsug hi yig de gzhin nyid/ /he ru ka nag g.yas rdo rje/ /mig tu oṃ las dkar po ni/ /gti mug rdo rje g.yas 'khor lo/ /rna bar hūṃ las nag po ni/ /zhe sdang rdo rje rdo rje g.yas/ /snar ni traṃ las ser po ste/ /ser sna rdo rje g.yas nor bu/ /lce rtsar āḥlas dmar po ste/ /'dod chags rdo rje g.yas pad ma/ /dpral par khaṃ las ljang khu ste/ /phrag dog sna tshogs rdo rje g.yas/ /snying gar haṃ las dkar po ste/ /dbang phyug dang po'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /phung po skye mched lha de rnams/ /kun kyang g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin/ /dbu rgyan ral pa'i cod pan 'dzin/ /sa khams ser po lte bar laṃ/ /ltung byed 'khor lo g.yas dang po'o/ /chu khams nag po snying gar māṃ/ /gsol byed rdo rje g.yas dang po'o/ /me khams dmar po mgrin par paṃ/ /'gugs byed pad+ma g.yas dang po'o/ /rlung khams ljang khu dpral par twāṃ/ /gar dbang ral gri g.yas dang po'o/ /de rnams phyag bzhi g.yas 'og ma'i/ /gri gug 'dzin cing g.yon gnyis na/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭ+waṃ 'dzin/ / mkha' khams dud kha gsang bar khaṃ/ /zhal gsum phyag drug dra ba can/ /dung dkar dmar ba g.yas gsum na/ /lcags kyu tshangs mgo gri gug 'dzin/ / g.yon pa gsum na thod pa dang*/ kha ṭ+waṃ ga dang zhags pa bsnams/ /lnga char dbu skra grol ba ste/ /phung khams skye mched lha bcu bdun/ spyan gsum g.yas rkyang stabs kyis bzhugs/ /oṃ pra kri ta pa ri shud+dha sarba dharmāḥpra kri ta pa ri shud+dho3 haṃ/ 'dir phung po/ skye mched kyi lha bcu gnyis las rnam snang sogs bzhi dang*/

gti mug rdo rje sogs lnga ste dgu po g.yas phyag mtshan 'phyar ba dang*/ rnam snang g.yon dkur bsten pa dang*/ gzhan rnams g.yon thugs kar gtod pa dang*/ lhag ma gsum po g.yon dkur bsten zhing*/ he ru ka g.yas sa gnon/ gzhan gnyis g.yas thugs kar bsten pa yin par 'grel pa'i dpe phal cher las bshad mod/ he ru ka sa gnon du byas pa ni dpe ma dag par mngon no/ /des na de yang thugs kar gtod pa'o/ /'on kyang phyag gi stangs ka gcig tu nges bzung dka' ba'i so so'i man ngag ltar bya'o/ /gsum pa la thog mar gur gyis srung ba ni/ sdig 'dzub dang se gol gtogs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ phyogs bzhi g.yas bskor gyis/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ grih+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bid+ya rā dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ 'od zer 'bar ba sngags kyi lus chen po/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi'i bar du khyab pa spros pas bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ 'od zer phyogs kyi mdog can du 'phros pas/ rdo rje'i ra ba gru bzhi pa dang*/ hūṃ las byung zhing hūṃ gis mtshan pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor la thug pa dang*/ hūṃ gi 'od zer las byung ba'i steng dang logs kun tu rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i mda'i dra ba dang*/ de'i 'og tu rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi nang thams cad du bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo gyur/ oṃ mi dī ni badz+ri bha wa badz+ra ban+dha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pra kā ra hūṃ paṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pañtsa ra hūṃ yaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bi ta na hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wā la a na lārka hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ sngags rnams lan gsum gsum brjod do/ /phyi nas bgegs la phur bus gdab pa ni/

yang sdig 'dzub skor zhing mtheb 'dzub kyi se gol phyogs bzhir gtogs pa'i mtshams rngam dang bcas/ sum+bha la sogs pa zhal bzhi pas sngags lan gnyis brjod/ phyogs bzhi'i sngags kyi 'od zer las byung ba'i sgo ma bzhi dang*/ 'od zer gnyis gnyis 'dus pa las mtshams ma bzhir gyur pa ni/ shar dang steng du khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang du 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub dang 'og tu khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lhor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang lte ba man chad phur bu'i dbyibs can/ g.yas rdo rje tho ba dang*/ g.yon rang mtshungs kyi phur bu thogs pa rnams su gyur te/ rnam 'khrul dpag tu med pa spros nas/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs thams cad phyogs skyong gi rnam par bkugahūṃ/ ring po brgyad brjod/ hūṃ/ las byung ba'i khron pa brgyad phyogs mtshams brgyad du gnas par gyur pa rnams su/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bcug de rnams kyi spyi bor phur bus btab/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+tan hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra kī la badz+ra dha ro a dz+nyā pa ya ti bi gh+nan badz+ra kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ lan bcu'am brgyad dam bsdu na gsum mo// phur bu rnams rdo rje tho bas rdungs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra mud gā ra badz+ra kī la ā ko ṭa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ grangs snga ma bzhin brjod/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar du phug pas/ bde ba chen po de bzhin nyid dang ro gcig tu gyur zhing*/ lhag ma rnams kyang tshar bcad/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa rdo rje ra ba la thim/ 'od zer phyir 'phros pa las/ rdo rje dang*/

pad+ma dang*/ 'khor lo'i ra ba zlum po rim pa gsum dum bu gcig tu gyur pas/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad mtshams bcings par gyur/ spros pa la dga' na/ oṃ badz+ra pra kā ra hūṃ/ sogs gsum dang*/ me sngags te sngags bzhi po brjod kyang rung ngo*/ /bzhi pa la gnyis las/ dang po bsod nams kyi tshogs ni/ srung 'khor gyi dbus su rang nyid he ru ka gsal ba'i thugs kar/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ aṃ las zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo hūṃ sngo skya ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin/ 'od zer lnga rnams 'phro ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas lus nang thams cad gang*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir song ste/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yab yum zhi khro rab 'byams thams cad spyan drangs te/ 'od zer rnams rang gi snying gar thim/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rnam dag rdo rje'i dbang phyug dang*/ /rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang zhing*/ /'dus dang dur khrod gnas pa yi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ma/ /kun la bdag ni gus phyag 'tshal/ / shrī he ru ka ar+ghaṃ=

nas / pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ de nas spro na/ 'grel pa las bshad pa ltar lha mo bcu drug gis mchod/ bsdu na/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe ā hūṃ/ de bzhin du/ dhu pe/ ā lo ka /gan+dhe/ nai wi te/ shap+ta zhes sbyar/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis kyis bstod/ bsgrod dka' srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /bdag gis 'gro rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /rang gi bdag nyid skad cig la/ /sangs rgyas rnams la dbul bar bgyi/ / zhes pa lan gcig dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang bzhan don ni rab sgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog/ ces lan gsum/ bar 'dir spro na thugs rgyud bskul ba'i don du yig brgya/ bzlas mi spro na mi dgos so/ / tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim/ / gnyis pa ye shes tshogs bsog ni/ snying gar he nag po/ mgrin par ru dmar po/ dpral par ka dkar po/ / yi ge gsum gyi don sgom bzhin du/ chos thams cad skye ba med pa la/ bdag dang bdag gir bzung bas sems can rnams 'khor bar gyur te/ de'i phyir bdag dpal he ru kar gyur nas/ gzung 'dzin dang bral ba'i tshul ji lta ba nyid du chos thams cad khong du chud par bgyi'o/ /oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ chos la dmigs pa'o/ / sems nyid nā da tsam gyi gzugs can de/ oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūṃ sngon po rnams steng nas steng du rtsegs pa/ de rnams las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs spros/ gnas gsum gyi sems can thams cad rdo rje gsum gyi go 'phang la bkod/

tshur 'dus rjes chags kyi zhu nas 'bru gsum la thim/ oṃ āḥl thim/ ā hūṃ la thim/ hūṃ gi zhabs kyu khog pa la thim/ khog pa mgo bo la/ mgo bo zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la/ thig le nā da la/ nā da skra'i rtse mo brgya stong gi cha tsam mo/ /sems can thams cad chos nyid khong du ma chud pas 'khor bar gyur te/ bdag gi chos nyid rtogs pas byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur bar bya'o/ /nā da yang mi dmigs par gyur/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ dmigs pa med pa'o/ /gnyis pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ stong pa'i ngang las nā da dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa nam mkhar bzhagade'i snang cha las byung ba/ 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de'i steng du suṃ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin can/ lcog brgyad dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus sngo ba/ de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'o/ / gsum pa 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ pad+ma'i lte bar g.yon bskor gyi/ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ a/ tshar gnyis/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo de yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang po me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /de'i steng du g.yas bskor gyi/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+sha tshar gnyis/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ de yongs su gyur pa las/

zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ / skabs 'dir nyi zla 'am zla ba dkar dmar kha sbyor dang*/ de yang so so'i yi ges mtshan pa dang zla ba dkar po kha sbyor dang*/ dbyangs gsal rnams las zla ba gcig pu/ kha dog dmar po'am/ dmar skya'am/ dkar po sgom pa sogs gang ltar yang spyir ni mi 'gal la/ kha sbyor mi byed na ye shes dang po gsum gyi dag pa sbyor tshul mi 'dra ba dgos so/ /stong nyid sgom pa nas de'i bar ni rnal 'byor dang po'o/ / nam mkhar gnas pa'i nā da de nyid zla ba kha sbyor gyi dbus su zhugs/ de las thig le/ de las zla tshes/ de las mgo bo/ de las ha/ de las zhabs kyu ste/ hūṃ yig dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can/ mchog tu dga' ba/ rgyu rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo ni/ so sor kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /de las 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros/ 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs mtha' yas pa sprul/ 'gro ba thams cad 'khor lo lnga'i rang bzhin du byas/ de rnams dang gdod ma'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams spyan drangs/ thams cad slar 'dus rjes chags kyis zhu ba hūṃ yig gi nā da la thim pa ni bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes so/ /de gnyis rjes su rnal 'byor ro/ / bzhi pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor la gsum te/ sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor sgom pa/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor sgom pa/ chos kyi dkyil 'khor sgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ zla ba hūṃ yig dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa lhan cig skyes dga'/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya wā k+tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dha sarba dharmaḥbadz+ra shud+dho3 haṃ/ ri rab kyi rtse mor srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje lte bar/

rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du nag po ljang khu dmar po ser po dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu dmar po'am ser po la rin po che'i phra yis mdzes pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa dang dril bu g.yer kha'i 'phreng ba dang*/ dar gyi chun 'phyang dang*/ zla ba rlung gis skyod pa dang*/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pas brgyan pa/ de'i steng du bya 'dab las thur du 'phyang ba'i ba ku li dang*/ steng du mda' yab pad+ma phyed pa'i rnam pas brgyan pa la/ sna tshogs pa'i gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pas mdzes pa/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus su in+d+ra nī la'i sa gzhi zlum por grub pa la gnas pa'i/ 'khor lo rim pa bzhi mchod rten zlum po'i bang rim gyi dbyibs ltar cung zad je mtho je mthor gyur pa'i lte bar bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa rtsa ba sdong bu ge sar dang bcas pa'i phyi rol du rin po che'am/ gri gug gis mtshan pa'i/ ra ba dang*/ ka ba dang*/ gdung dang*/ thog phug la sogs pas mdzes par byas pa/ de'i phyir rol du thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon pau rtsibs brgyad pa rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ra ba dang*/ ka ba dang*/ gdung dang*/ thog phub la sogs pas mdzes par byas pa/ de'i phyi rol du gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa pad+ma'i mtshan pa'i ra ba dang*/ ka ba dang*/ gdung dang*/ thog phub la sogs pas mdzes par byas pa/ de'i phyi rol tu sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa 'khor los mtshan pa'i ra ba dang*/ ka ba dang*/ gdung dang*/ thog phub la sogs pas mdzes par byas pa/ gzhal yas khang gi nang gi gzhi dam tshig 'khor lo dang steng thog gi mdog ni/ shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser ba/ gtso bo'i gnas kyi dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor/

rdo rje dang rin po che tog gis brgyan pa/ sgo 'khyud kyi phugs dang*/ rtsig pa'i zur la/ zla ba phyed pa la gnas pa'i nor bus brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol gyi 'gram na 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po'i steng na mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas 'khod pa/ sgo khang bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i rtse mor/ pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol gyi khyam la mchod rdzas du mas mdzes pa/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad ni/ shar du drag tu gtum pa/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ nub tu 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ lhor 'jigs su rung ba/ mer nags tshal phun sum tshogs pa/ bden bral du mun pa mi zad pa/ rlung du ki li ki li'i sgra rab tu sgrog pa/ dbang ldan du ha ha dgod pa'o/ /shing brgyad ni shar du shi ri sha /byang du a shod tha/ nub tu kang ke la/ lhor tsu ta/ mer ka rañtsa/ bden bral du la ta par ka ti/ rlung du parti pa ta/ dbang ldan du bā tra'o/ phyogs skyong brgyad ni/ shar du dbang po/ byang du gnod sbyin/ nub tu chu lha/ lhor gshin rje/ mer byin za/ bden bral du srin po/ /rlung du rlung bdag dbang ldan du 'byung po'o/ /klu brgyad ni/ shar du nor rgyas/ byang du 'jog po/ nub tu stobs kyi rgyu/ lhor pad+ma/ mer hū lun ta/ bden bral du rigs ldan/ rlung du dung skyong*/ dbang ldan du pad+ma chen po'o/ / sprin gyi bdag po brgyad ni/ shar du sgra grags pa/ byang du smugs pa/ nub tu mun pa can/ lhor kun tu 'khyil ba/ mer gang ba/ bden bral du 'bab pa/ rlung du drag po/ dbang ldan du 'khrigs pa'o/ /shing rnams la brten pa'i zhing skyong brgyad ni/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi gzugs 'dzin pa'o/ /gzhan yang dur khrod de dag tu chu chen po brgyad dang*/

me chen po brgyad dang*/ ri chen po brgyad dang*/ mchod rten brgyad la sogs pas yongs su gang ba ste/ gzhan yang ro dang keng rus dang*/ gsal shing gis phug pa dang*/ dpyangs pa dang*/ dum bu dang 'thor ba la sogs pas gang ba/ bya dang*/ gcan gzan sna tshogs lang long du rgyu zhing*/ lce spyang gi sgras khyab pa/ grub chen rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa'i slob dpon dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*/ 'jigs pa'i gzugs can dang*/ ro langs dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ srin po dang sha za du mas khyab pa/ dngos grub kyi rdzas dang mchod pa sna tshogs pas gang ba'o/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus kyi lte bar 'khor lo bde mchog bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka in+d+ra nī la ltar 'bar ba'i 'od zer can gyi sku mdog mthing nag zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sku lus dang mtshungs pa char sprin gsar pa'i mdog can cher khros shing 'jigs su rung ba/ g.yon zhal ljang gu/ rgyab zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal ser po zhal re re la dmar zhing bkra la rab tu 'khrug pas spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ mche ba rnon po gtsigs pa/ rnam par 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa khrag dang bcas pa rgyangs te 'dzin pas tshul gyis stod g.yogs su bsnams pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍa ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa ni gri gug /drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na rdo rje mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+waṃ ga /bzhi pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan gyi steng du/ zhabs g.yas rkyang bas dus mtshan dmar mo gan rkyal du gnas pa'i nu ma'i steng dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po kha bub tu gnas pa'i rna ba g.yon pa'i steng nas brdzis pa/

stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris grol ba/ ral pa'i cod pan thor tshugs bcings pa'i rtse mor 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i nor bu dang*/ g.yon ngos su zla ba phyed pa dang*/ ral pa'i mdun ngos la sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ dbu re re la rdo rje nag po'i 'phreng ba la brgyus pa'i mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs bcings pa/ mi'i rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i mi mgo khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ spyi bo'i nor bu dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ phyag gdub dang*/ tshangs skud dang*/ thal chen te phyag rgya drug dang*/ zhabs gdub dang dpung gdub dang*/ 'og pag las dpyangs pa rus pa'i drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa/ dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra dang bcas pa'i ske rags la sogs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ / dgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung*/ /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba ste/ gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ de'i yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar po/ bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ drag mo chen mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yon pas bdud sogs gdug pa can gyi khrag dang*/ mi'i rgyu mas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin zhing*/ yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pas rgyab zhal du stob pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje'i gri gug 'dzin pa'i sdigs 'dzub kyis phyogs kun rnam par gnon zhing sdang ba dang gdug pa'i sems can thams cad bsdigs par mdzad pa/ gcer bu ba spu langs shing*/ dbu skra sil bur grol ba/ nu ma 'khrang zhing rgyas la lang tsho la bab pa/ khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khyud pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang*/ thod pa'i cod pan can/ mi mgo skam po lnga bcu'i 'phreng ba dang ldan pa/ gnyis ka'ang bde ba chen po dang thugs rje'-i bdag nyid can/ dus mtha'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/

/yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ dkar po las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa/ byāṃ las byung ba'i nor bu dmar po rtse mor byāṃ ser pos mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' khams mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥdamar po las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa/ d+yāṃ las byung ba'i ze'u 'bru dkar po rtse mo d+yāṃ ser pos mtshan pa/ yab kyi lte ba dang yum gyi mgrin par zla ba la/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yab kyi thugs ka dang yum gyi dpral par zla gdan la/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra bar+ṇa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yab kyi mgrin pa dang yum gyi lte bar nyi ma la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ ba ra swāhā/ yab kyi dpral pa dang yum gyi thugs kar/ nyi gdan la oṃ hrīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags rnams kha dog dmar po g.yon bskor du gnas shing 'od zer 'phro ba/ yab yum phan tshun zhal sbyor ba na/ sngags dang 'od zer sbyor bas kyang 'khyud cing*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes rgyas shing brtan par gyur/ bde chen 'khor lo'i 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu khaṇ+ḍa ro ha dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ bzhi char yang zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum skra grol ba/ phyag g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis kyi thod khrag dang kha ṭ+waṃ ga 'dzin pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang*/ mi mgo'i do shal dang*/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ gcer mo lang tsho la bab cing*/ bha ga dang nu 'bur mtho ba/ bde ba rgyas pa'i nyams can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis me ri 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /mtshams bzhir bdud rtsis lngas gang ba'i bum pa'i steng du/ ka pā la byang chub kyi sems la sogs pas gang ba dang bcas par gyur/ de'i phyi rol du thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs pul+lir ma yar/

thod pa'i dum bu dang rab tu gtum mo/ /byang rtsibs dza lan+dha rar keng rus chen po dang*/ gtum pa'i mig can ma/ nub rtsibs o ṭi ya ṇar keng rus dang 'od ldan ma/ lho rtsibs arbu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma shar lho go da war ri lha'i dgra dang dpa' bo'i blo can ma/ lho nub ri sma shwa rar 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ nub byang de bi ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ byang shar ma la bar rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste/ thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog nag po ste nam mkha' la spyod pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol du gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs kā ma ru par/ myu gu can dang sa srung ma/ byang rtsibs o trer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen po/ nub rtsibs tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ lho rtsibs ko sa lar rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ shar lho ka ling kar rab tu bzang po dang sngo sangs lha mo/ lho nub lam pa dkar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ nub byang kañtsir 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ byang shar hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma ste/ gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog dmar po ste/ sa steng na spyod pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol sku'i 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang rtsibs gri ha de bar rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma/ nub rtsibs so raṣ+tar rta mgrin dang chang tshong ma/ lho rtsibs bar+ṇa dī par nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ shar lho na ga rar khrag 'thung dang shin tu dpa' mo/ lho nub sin+dhur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ nub byang ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los sgyur ma/ byang shar ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen po ste/

sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo/ kha dog dkar po ste sa 'og na spyod pa'o/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi po thams cad/ dpal he ru ka'i rigs las byung ba he ru ka dang mtshungs pa ste/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ thod pa'i cod pan dang*/ mgo bo'i 'phreng ba dang*/ phyag rgya drug dang*/ stag lpags gsar pa'i smad dkris can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum ma/ dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyi ḍa ma ru dang kha ṭ+waṃ ga 'dzin pa'o/ /rnal 'byor ma nyer bzhi po thams cad ni/ rdo rje phag mo'i rigs las byung ba phag mo dang mtshungs pa ste/ skra grol ba/ phyag lnga rgya dang*/ thod skam gyi do shal dang ldan pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khyud pa'o/ /dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i shar sgor khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang*/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba brgyad ka'ang*/ drag mo chen po cher khros pa ro'i gdan la gnas pa/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams 'joms par mdzad pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i= nas/ me ri 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar snying po'i rnal 'byor ma'i skabs bzhin dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dpral par thod pa'i steng du rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa'o/ /

de nas skabs 'dir byang phyogs kyi dag dran byed pa'ang rung mod kyi/ gzhung gi dngos bstan ni bshad pa'i go rim tsam yin pas/ 'og tu byas na legs so/ / gnyis pa nang lus dkyil ni/ rkang pa gnyis rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying ga sa/ sgal tshig ri rab/ skra sen pags pa rus tshigs rnams srung ba'i 'khor lo/ bu ga brgyad ni dur khrod brgyad/ lus 'dom gang gru bzhi ni gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ lus ngag yid gsum 'khor lo gsum/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo ni bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo/ 'byung bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'-i rtsa ni sgo bzhi/ rkang brgyad ni ka ba brgyad/ dbang po rnams ni me long la sogs pa'i rgyan/ spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab so gnyis ni pad+ma'i 'dab ma der rgyu ba'i rlung dang thig le ni ā l̥ kā l̥/ klad pa ni zla ba kha sbyor/ haṃ yig ni rgyu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa/ de las skyes pa'i rtsa khams ni lha rnams te/ rtsa la la na dang ra sa na'i 'khor dang bcas shing*/ lte ba'i aṃ yig gi bcud dang ldan pa'i rtsa a wa dhu tī ni rdo rje phag mo dang*/ snying ga'i dbus kyi gzhom du med pa'i thig le hūṃ gi rnam pa yungs kar sbom po'i tshad tsam kha ba 'dzag pa lta bur gnas pa ni dpal he ru ka ste/ sku mdog thing nag sngo ljang dmar ser zhal/ /rdo rje dril bu glang lpags ḍā ma ru/ /dgra sta gri gug rtse gsum kha ṭ+waṃ ga /thod khrag zhags pa tshangs mgo gdong bzhi 'dzin/ /g.yas brkyang pad nyir 'jigs byed dus mtshan brdzis/ /de la 'khyud pa'i yum mchog rnal 'byor ma/ /dmar mo rdo rje thod khrag gang 'dzin/ / gnyis ka'ang me dpung dbus na rgyan dang bcas/ /snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i nang bskor rtsa 'dab brgyad la/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi 'byung bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba dang bcas pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma/ byang du lā ma/ nub tu khaṇ+ḍa ro ha/ lhor gzugs can ma'o/

/mtshams bzhir gnas pa bdud rtsi lnga bab pa mchod pa'i rtsa bzhi ni rab tu gang ba'i bum thod bzhir gyur/ puṃ dzaṃ oṃ aṃ goṃ riṃ deṃ māṃ/ kāṃ oṃ triṃ koṃ kāṃ laṃ kaṃ hiṃ/ preṃ griṃ sauṃ sum nāṃ siṃ maṃ kuṃ/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ rtsa nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ khams nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhir gyur/ spyi bo pul+li ra ma la yar thod pa'i dum bu dang rab tu gtum mo/ /spyi gtsug dza lan+dha rar keng rus chen mo dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ rna ba g.yas pa o ṭi ya ṇa ra keng rus dang 'od ldan ma/ ltag par arbu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs ma dang sna chen ma ste gnas so/ /rna ba g.yas pa go da ba rir lha'i dgra dang dpa' bo'i blo can ma/ smin ma'i dbus ri smi shwa rar 'od dpag med dang me'u thung ma/ mig gnyis de wī ko ṭar rdo rje 'od dang lang ga'i dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa gnyis ma la bar rdo rje sku dang shing grib ma ste nye ba'i gnas so/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'o/ /mchan khung gnyis kā ma ru par myu gu can dang sa srung ma/ nu ma gnyis o trer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo ste zhing ngo*/ /lte ba tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ sna rtse ko sa lar rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang chang thung ma ste/ nye ba'i zhing ngo*/ kha ka liṃ gar rab tu bzang po dang sngo sangs lha mo/ mgrin pa laṃ pa kar rdo rje bzang mo dang shin tu bzang po ste tshan do ha'o/ /snying ka kañtsar 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ 'dom par hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang kha ga na te nye ba'i tshan do ha'o/ /gsung gi 'khor lo'o/ /mtshan ma pre ta pū rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ bshang lam gri ha de bar rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma ste 'du ba'o/ /brla gnyis sau raṣ+tar rta mgrin dang chang 'tshong ma/

byin pa gnyis su par+ṇa dwī bar nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste nye ba'i 'du ba'o/ /rkang sor brgyad nā ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ bol gong gnyis sin+dhur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma ste dur khrod do/ /rkang pa'i mthe bong gnyis ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los sgyur ma/ pus mo gnyis ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste/ nye ba'i dur khrod do/ /sku'i 'khor lo'o/ /bu ga rnams kyi rtsa sgo mtshams ma brgyad du gyur pa ni/ lce'i rtsa bar kha gdong ma/ lte bar 'ug gdong ma/ rtags kyi sgor khyi gdong ma/ bshang lam gyi sgor phag gdong ma/ mdzod pu'i bug par gshin rje brtan ma/ rna ba gnyis kyi sgor gshin rje pho nya ma/ mig gnyis kyi sgor gshin rje mche ba ma/ sna bug gnyis kyi sgor gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ / gsum pa chos kyi dkyil 'khor ni bshad rgyud dag dang gzhung gi tshig rigs dngos bstan ltar/ brjod na'ang legs la/ yang na 'di ltar bya ste/ lus dang tshor ba dang chos dang sems rjes su dran pa nyer bar bzhag pa bzhi ni/ mkha' 'gro ma/ lā ma/ khaṇ+ḍa ro ha/ gzugs can ma bzhi'o/ /'dun pa dang brtson 'grus dang spyod pa dang sems te rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ni/ rab gtum ma/ gtum mig ma/ 'od ldan ma/ sna chen ma bzhi'o/ /dad pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ dran pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ shes rab ste dbang po lnga ni dpa' blo ma/ mi thung ma/ lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ shing grib ma/ sa srung ma rnams so/ /dad sogs kyi stobs lnga ni/ /'jigs byed ma/ /rlung shugs ma/ chang thung ma/ sngo sangs lha mo/ rab bzang ma rnams so/ /ting nge 'dzin dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ shin tu sbyangs pa dang*/ rnam 'byed dang*/ dran pa dang btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag bdun ni/ rta rna ma/ bya gdong ma/ 'khor shugs ma/ dum skyes ma/

chang 'tshong ma/ go cha ma/ shin tu dpa' mo rnams so/ /yang dag pa'i lta ba dang*/ rtog pa dang*/ ngag dang*/ las kyi mtha' dang*/ 'tsho ba dang*/ rtsol ba dang*/ dran pa rnams ni stobs chen ma/ 'khor sgyur ma/ rtson chen ma/ khwa gdong ma/ 'ug gdong ma/ khyi gdong ma/ phag gdong ma rnams so/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal he ru ka'o/ /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa bskyed pa dang*/ skyes pa srung ba dang*/ mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa mi bskyed pa dang*/ skyes pa spong ba bzhi ni/ gshin rje brtan ma/ pho nya ma/ mche ba ma/ 'joms ma bzhi'o/ / shin tu bsdus na/ lha sum cu rtsa bdun byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi bdag nyid do/ / zhes pa tsam zhig gis kyang chog mod kyi/ las dang po pa la dkyus ltar legs so/ /'dir don ni/ rjes chags lhan skyes kyis bde bas dkyil 'khor thams cad la rgyas btab cing*/ snang stong bde ba'i ye shes de nyid la byang phyogs so bdun tshang bar shes par byas nas/ lha rnams der dag tshul dran par byed dgos pa yin no/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dha sarba dharma badz+ra shud+dho3 haṃ/ lan gsum sogs brjod/ 'dir pha mthing pa nas brgyud pa'i man ngag las/ pho nya gsum bsre ba'i gdams pa ston pa ni/ rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di'i bskyed rim gyi gdams pa'i gnad bla na med pa yin pas/ ma chad par bsgom pa gal che'o/ /'di skad cig rnams pa'i gsang sngags yin pas/ 'di dang de 'gal bar mi bsam ste/ don de yang skad cig rnam pa'i don la rjes su zhugs pa'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa byin gyis rlobs pa'i rnal 'byor ni rnam pa gnyis te go cha bgo ba dang ye shes pa gzhug pa'o/ /de yang*/ rang gi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po las rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor nā ma hi ser po las rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swāhā hūṃ dmar po las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣa ṭa he nag po las dpal he ru ka

mig gnyis su hūṃ hūṃ ho dmar ser las rdo rje nyi ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa haṃ ljang khu las rta mchogayum gyi lte bar oṃ bam dmar po las rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon po las gshin rje ma/ mgrin par hrīṃ moṃ dkar mo las rmongs byed ma mgo bor hriṃ hriṃ ser po las skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃ hūṃ ljang khu las skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha las tsiṇ+ḍi kā /rdo rje sems dpa' dang rmongs byed ma zla ba la/ gnas shing zla ba'i 'od can/ gzhan rnams nyi ma la gnas shing nyi ma'i 'od can no/ / spro na 'di skad ces/ rdor sems phag mo zhal gsum phyag drug ste/ /gzhan rnams zhal gcig phyag bzhi kun g.yas brkyang*/ /rdor sems phag mos 'khyud cing dkar dmar nag /g.yas na rdo rje cang te'u mgo bo ste/ /g.yon na dril bu thod pa kha ṭ+waṃ ga /rnam snang gshin rje mas 'khyud 'khor lo 'dzin/ /gar dbang rmongs byed mas 'khyud pad+ma dmar/ khrag 'thung skyong byed mas 'khyud rdo rje ste/ /nyi ma skrag byed mas 'khyud rin po che/ /rta mchog tsaṇ+ḍi kas 'khyud ral gri'o/ /lnga char g.yon gyi dang po dril bu bsnams/ /lhag ma cang te'u g.yas dang kha ṭ+waṃ ga /thod par bcas pa g.yon gyi 'og mas 'dzin/ /phag mo dmar sngo ljang ba'i zhal gsum ste/ /lcags kyu tshangs mgo gri gug g.yas gsum na/ /thod pa kha ṭ+waṃ zhags pa g.yon pas 'dzin/ /gshin rje ma sogs lnga ni gri thod dang*/ /dril bus mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+waṃ cang te'u bsnams/ zhes so/ /sku'i cha byad gzhan rnams dkyil 'khor gyi lhas rigs 'gre la/ bsdu na sngags kyi yig 'bru nyid lha'i ngo bor bsgoms pas kyang chog go /de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas te/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ma thams cad ye shes sems dpa' dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs par gyur/

pheṃ/ zhes brjod/ 'od zer rang gi snying gar thim/ rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa 'og nas 'byung ba ltar phul nas/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ rnam lnga 'dod skor gyi mthar 'khyud rgya byas la/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ byang phyogs kyi dag pa'i 'jug thogs sam lus dkyil gyi rjes thogs nyid la/ skad cig rnam pas sngags kyi pho nya gsum bsres byas zin na 'dir mi dgos la/ de dag tu ma byas na 'dir byed de 'grel ba'i dgongs pa'ang yin no/ / slar yang snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs spyan drangs phaiṃ/ chu gnyis spyod dang bcas pas tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ dpa' bo rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ rdo rje phag mo snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang bcas pas ḍā ma ru dang bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa thogs nas/ dbang bskur rol mo bde chen po/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dra dgyes bde/ /dgyes mdzad gsang ba'i bde chen po/ stsol mdzad bde ba chen po ste/ / a la la la ho/ mchog tu gyur pa'i bde chen po/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i bde chen po/ a la la la ho/ zhes pa'i glu dbyangs dang*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gi khrus bgyi'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrīḥhūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du byas/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud so so'i spyi bor 'khyil ba yongs su gyur pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/

rdo rje phag mo la rnam snang*/ bde chen 'khor lo pa rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan/ thugs kyi 'khor lo pa rnams la mi bskyod pa/ gsung gi 'khor lo pa rnams la 'od dpag med/ sku'i 'khor lo pa rnams la rnam snang*/ dam tshig 'khor lo pa rnams la don yod grub pas dbu rgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim/ de ltar na zla ba sa bon ro gcig tu 'dres pa nas bzung ste de yan chad shin tu rnal 'byor ro/ / bdun pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor ni lha sku la sems mnyam par bzhag cing*/ mthar/ oṃ a ā/ nas/ ha k+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rang gi sna bug g.yas nas ā l̥ kā l̥'i 'od zer dang 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs spros/ 'gro ba thams cad de'i rang bzhin du byas/ gdod nas grub pa rnams dang lhan cig slar 'dus nas sna bug g.yon pa nas zhugs/ lte bar ā l̥ kā l̥ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ā l̥ kā l̥s mtshan pa dbus su hūṃ dang bcas par gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba'o/ / de la cung zad mnyam par bzhag de ni rdo rje sems dpa' phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro/ / lte ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum rjes chags kyi sbyor bas snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba sgyu ma lta bu'i sgra dang 'od zer gyi srid gsum dag pa'i 'khor lor byas pa/ srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ de dur khrod brgyad la thim/ de dam tshig gi 'khor lo la/ de yang sku'i 'khor lo la/ de yang gsung gi 'khor lo la/ de yang thugs kyi 'khor lo la/ de yang bde chen 'khor la/ de yang gtso bo'i zhal bzhi la/ de yang lte ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum la thim/ de yang snyoms 'jug bde ba chen pos rab tu zhu te hūṃ yig dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags par gyur/

hūṃ gi zhabs kyu khog pa la/ de mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la/ de la cung zad sems bzung zhing mthar nā da yang 'od gsal du thim/ 'dir bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor sgom/ slar yang stong pa'i ngang las dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo snga ma ltar grub par gyur/ de dag ni rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /brgyad pa mchod pa'i rnal 'byor las dang po sngags mchod ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam ba raṃ swāhā/ gtso bo'i snying po'o/ / oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yum gyi snying po'o/ /oṃ ḍā ki nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ lā me ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi ṇī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i sngags so/ / oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta badz+rā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa thod pa bzhi'i sngags su bhi bhu ti bzhed do/ / oṃ ka ra ka ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pra tsaṇ+ḍi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ku ru ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍi ak+ṣi ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ban+dha ban+dha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pra bha wa tī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ trā sa ya trā sa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā nā se hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bā ri ma tī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hroṃ hroṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kharba rī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hraḥhraḥhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ laṅke shwa rī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ phem phem hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dru ma ts+tsha ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ phaṭa phaṭa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ e rā wa ti ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā bhai ra wi ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ wa yu be ge hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bha k+ṣa bha k+ṣa wa sa ru dhi rān+ṭa mā lā ba lam+bi nī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su ra bhak+ṣi ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/

oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa sap+ta pa tā la ga ra bhu dzaṃ ga sarbaṃ bā tardza ya tardza ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sh+yā ma de wi ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā kaḍh+ya ā kaḍh+yah+ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su bha dre hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hriṃ hriṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ha ya kar+ṇe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dz+nyauṃ dz+nyau hūṃ ༷hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kha gā na ne hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ k+ṣ+maṃ k+ṣ+maṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra be ge hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ haṃ haṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hiṃ hiṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shauṇ+ḍi nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra war+m+mi ṇī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ki li ki li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su bī re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ si li si li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā ba le hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hi li hi li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra warti nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dhi li dhi li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā bī d+yai hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/

dang po nyer bzhi dpa' bo nyer bzhi dang*/ phyi ma nyer bzhi dpa' mo nyer bzhi'i sngags so/ / oṃ ka kā s+yai hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ u lū kā s+yai hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shwa nā s+yai hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sū ka rā s+yai hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ sgo ma bzhi'i sngags so/ / oṃ ya ma dā ḍhī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dū tī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma daṃ ṣ+ti ṇī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ma thā nī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ mtshams ma bzhi'i sngags so/ /phyi mchod dngos su bshams yod na byin rlabs bya dgos shing*/ ting nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig gi mchod pa la ni/ bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs dgos pa ma yin no/ /byin rlabs ni/ sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a yig las byung ba'i thod pa'i snod rnams kyi nang du/ hūṃ las 'byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs gsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa bzang zhing rgya che la dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du pād+yaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gan+de/ nai bi te/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ rol mo byin rlabs kyi sngags kyang spro na brjod/ gong tshogs zhing gi skabs bzhin nam/ bla ma gong ma 'ga' zhig gi lag len ltar na/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+bha ra maṇ+ḍal tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi nī/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe man chad la pra tīts+tsha'i dod du āḥhūṃ sbyar ro/ /de ni phyi mchod dngos yin la/ oṃ bī ni badz+ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ waṃ s+ya/ mṛ taṃ gi mu ra dze/ ha s+ya/ lā s+ya/ girti/ nṛ ti/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ dī pe/ gan+dhe/ rū pa/ rā sa/ par+she/ oṃ dharma dha tu badz+ra ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gi mchod de/ 'di yang phyi mchod gtso che ba'i dbang du byas so/

/de nas nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs nas/ oṃ a mṛ ta ut+ta ga hūṃ hūṃ tha tha traṃ a khaṃ hūṃ zhes brjod/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje phag mo dang*/ /grub chen lū yi pa dang ḍaṃ ki pa/ /lwa ba pa dang dza lan+dha ra dang*/ /nag po spyod pa dge ba'i mgon po dang*/ /te lo nā ro ma na ka shrī/ /bha dan+da pa mar pa do pa dang*/ /bde mchog rdo rje bze ba blo ldan dang*/ /slob dpon khu ba slob dpon la tshad pa/ /lo tsā mchog ldan dpal ldan seng ge dang*/ /mkhan chen bu ston dharma shrī dang*/ /rgyal ba dpal legs 'dus pa bzang po dang*/ /thar pa'i mtshan can rig 'dzin rgyal po dang*/ /don grub rgyal mtshan bkra shis rgyal mtshan dang*/ /dpal ldan chos bzang £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ lha dbang grags pa dang*/ /kun mkhyen sgrol mgon ye shes rgya mtsho dang*/ /snying po'i blo gros ngag dbang 'phrin las dang*/ /kun bzang dbang po tshe dbang nor bu'i zhabs/ /'phrin las shing rta bstan pa'i nyin mor byed/ /zur mang lo chen karma rin chen dpal/ /'od gsal 'gyur med ma ṇi bha dra dang*/ /chos 'phel rgya mtsho ngag dbang chos 'dzin dpal/ /mkhas grub dbang phyug tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho dang*/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma £© rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ yang na/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /phyag na rdo rje sa ra ha pa dang*/ /klu sgrub shā ba ri dang lū yi pa/ /dā ri pa dang slob dpon rnam rgyal zhabs/ /til+li nā ro pa dang phaṃ thing mched/ /klog skya mal lo sa skya gong ma lnga/ /dkon mchog dpal dang grub chen brag phug pa/ /chos rje bla ma'i zhabs dang dpal tshul ba/ /shar pa ngor chen paṇa chen shākya'i mtshan/ /rab gsal zla mgon rje btsun grol mchog dang*/ / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan rnams la 'bul/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes so/ /sa lugs la brgyud lugs mi 'dra ba mang zhing*/ pu rangs lo chung dang rwa lugs kyi brgyud pa'ang yod do/

/de nas bsdu na gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pa dang*/ rgyas par spro na gong sngags mchod kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar/ dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyis sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags la 'bul/ oṃ a mṛ ta swa da na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kā mi nu sarba bhak+ṣa shwa dha ya/ gu h+ya badz+ri ṇī swāhā/ nang mchod do/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ gsang ba'i mchod pa'o/ /de nas rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis bstod pa bya ste/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti wī re sha ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā kalpāg+ni san+ni bhā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dza ṭā mu ku ṭot+ka ṭā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ daṃṣ+ta ka rā lo gra bhi ṣa ṇa mu khā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bha su rā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ par shu pā sho d+yā ta shu la kha ṭ+waṃ gi dha ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ byā gh+rā dzi nī ba ra dha ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā dhu mrān+dha kā ra wa pu ṣā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes yab kyi rkang brgyad dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti badz+ra pā ra hī ba hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo ār+ya a pa ra dzi te trai lo kya mā te mahā bit+yā shwa re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥsarba bhu ta bha yā ba he ma hā badz+re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra ā sa ni a dzi te a par dzi te ba shaṃ kā ri nai tra bh+ra ma ṇe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥsho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ni kro dha ka rā li ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥtra sa ni ma ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa ra dza ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzam+bha n-i/ stam+bha ni mo ha ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra wā rā hi mahā yo ki nī kā me shwa ri kha ge hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes yum gyi rkang brgyad do/ /yang na mchod pa'i rnal 'byor bdun pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin brgyad par byas nas/ skabs 'dir ting nge 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor sgom pa yang yod pa/

bskyed rim gzhan gyi rim pa dang mthun te/ 'di ltar byed na mchod pa rjes su rnal 'byor gyi yan lag tu bsdu ba yin no/ /de nas bzlas pa la bzla bya'i sngags ni/ gong du bstan pa'i yab kyi rkang brgyad kyi rkang pa re re'i hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa rnams dang*/ dang po'i oṃ ma gtogs pa'i oṃ rnams kyang dor ba la/ ka ra ka ra sogs btags pa ste/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ sogs/ wa pu ṣā ya/ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ ban+dha ban+dha/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya/ hrauṃ hrauṃ/ hraḥhraḥ pheṃ pheṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ba su ru dhir an+d+ra mā la ba lam+bi ni gṛh+na gṛh+na sap+ta pa ta la ga ta bhu dzāṃ ga sarbaṃ pa tardza ya tardza ya ā kaḍh+ya ā kaḍh+ya/ hriṃ hriṃ/ dz+nyā+auṃ dz+nyā+auṃ/ k+ṣ+maṃ k+ṣ+maṃ/ haṃ haṃ hiṃ hiṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ ki li ki li/ si li si li/ hi li hi li/ dhi li dhi li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ yab kyi rtsa sngags so/ /gong du bshad pa'i yum gyi rkang brgyad la/ thog ma'i oṃ ma gtogs/ oṃ yig dang hūṃ phaṭa rnams dor ba la/ tad+ya thā pro taṃ gi sogs btags pa yab kyi dang 'dra bar bod gong ma rnams bzhed la/ 'dir lwa ba pa'i bzhed pa ltar rkang brgyad dang ma sbrel bar bzla ste/ oṃ badz+ra bā rā hī/ pro taṅge pro taṅge/ ha na ha na prā ṇāṃ/ kiṃ ki ṇi*/ khiṃ khi ni/ dhu na dhu na badz+ra ha ste/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya badz+ra/ ṣa ṭ+wāṃ ga ka pā la dha ra ṇi/ mahā bi shi te/ māṃ sa a sha naṃ/ ma nus sh+yan+t+ra/ prā bri te sān+ni dh+yaṃ na ra shi ro mā lā gran+thi ta dha ri ṇi/ sum+bha ni sum+bha/ ha na ha na prā ṇāṃ/ sarba pā paṃ sa twā naṃ/ sarba pā shū nāṃ/ mahā maṃ sa tshe da naṃ/ kro dha mūrte daṃṣ+ta ka rā li ni/ mahā mu dre/ shrīḥhe ru ka de ba s+ya a gra ma hi shi sa ha sra shi ri/ sa ha sra wā ha we/ sha ta sa ha sra ā na ne/ dz+wa li ta te dza se/ dz+wa la mu khe/ piṃ ga la lo tsa ne/ badz+ra sha rī re/ badz+ra ā sa ni/

mi li te tsi li te/ he he/ ha ha/ hūm̐ hūṃ/ kha kha/ dhu dhu/ ru ru/ dhu ru dhu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ muñtsa muñtsa/ a dwe te/ mahā yo gi nī/ pa ṭhi ta sid+dhi/ draiṃ dhaṃ drai dhaṃ/ graṃ graṃ/ he he/ ha ha bhī me/ ha sa ha sa/ bī re/ hā hā ho hoḥ hūṃ hūṃ/ trai lokya bi nā sha ni/ sha ta/ sa ha sra ko ṭi/ ta thā ga ta pa ri wa re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ siṃ ha rū pe khaḥ ga dza rū pe āḥ tre lokya u da re sa mu dra me kha le gra sa gra sa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ wī rā dwai te hūṃ hūṃ/ ha haḥ mahā pa shu mo ha ni mahā yo gi shwa ri s+t+waṃ/ ṭā ka nī sar+b+ba lo kā naṃ ban+dha ni/ sa d+yaḥpra t+ya ya kā ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ bhū ta trā sa ni/ mahā bī rī/ pa ra ma sid+dhi/ yo gī shwa ri phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yum gyi rtsa sngags so/ /yab yum gyi snying po ni gong du bstan zin to/ / oṃ hrīḥ ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ nye snying ngo*/ oṃ sarba budha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra bar+ṇa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yum gyi nye snying ngo*/ /'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs kyi sngags ni sngar bstan pa bzhin no/ /go cha'i sngags la sa bon kho na dang*/ sa bon la mgo bor oṃ dang hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa sbyar ba dang*/ mtshan sngags kyang par bstan pa ste rim pa gsum yod pa las/ skabs 'dir dang po bzung ngo*/ /bgrang 'phreng gi rab tu dbye ba dang 'phreng ba byin rlabs dang*/ bzlas pa'i rab tu dbye ba rnams kyang ji skad bshad pa dang bla ma'i ngag las rtogs par byas te/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni/ do li'i bzlas pa dang*/ spro bsdu'i bzlas pa gtso bor byed cing*/ ngag gi bya ba'i dbang du byas na ngag bzlas dang*/ yid bzlas dang*/ 'gog bzlas gsum ga yang bya'o/ /dgu pa nyer bsdu'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ srid gsum dag pa'i 'khor lo/ zhes pa nas/ bde chen 'khor lo la lha rnams phyogs g.yon bskor dang mtshams g.yas bskor gyis sna bug nas thim/

yum yang yab la thim/ lus dkyil gyi lha drug cu yang rang gnas su thim/ gtso bo yang thugs ka'i he ru ka yab yum la thim/ de yang snyoms 'jug bde ba chen po'i/ nas/ nā da lnga 'od gsal du thim/ de la cung zad mnyam par bzhagaslar yang rang nyid dpal he ru ka'i sku'i rnam par gyur/ gnyis pa mnyam langs la bcu ste/ srung ba'i rnal 'byor dang*/ zhing skyong dang*/ spyod lam dang*/ kha zas dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma dang*/ rjes chags dang*/ nyal ba dang*/ ldang ba dang*/ khrus kyi rnal 'byor rnams so/ /dang po srung ba ni/ dpa' bo'i rtsa ba'i sngags sogs gang*/ /tshangs pa'i skud pa sogs su rtag/dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi yis/ /lus kyi khams la rtag pa'o/ /dpa' bo'i go cha drug po yis/ /phyag rgya yis na ni lus mdzes pa'o/ /rdo rje'i phag mo'i sngags gang yin/ /mgrin pa mgur chus brgyan pa'o/ /lha yi snying po'i sngags kyis ni/ /'phreng ba brgya yi phyed kyi mdzes/ /yi ge bdun pa'i gsang sngags kyis/ /gdub bskor gyis ni rna ba mdzes/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro mas/ /pags pa'i gos mchog 'dzin pa'o/ /rnal 'byor ma drug gsang sngags kyis/ /ske rags byas pas brgyan pa'o/ /'khor lo kun gyi rnal 'byor ma'i/ /sngags ni ltung ba'i thod pa'o/ /rnam snang mdzad ces sngags gang yin/ /thod pas dbu la brgyan pa'o/ kha ṭ+waṃ ga ni lha yi sku /shes rab ḍā ma ru yi sgra /nyin mo bcom ldan dpa' bo ste/ /rnal 'byor ma ni mtshan mor brjod/ /mya ngan 'das byung dpa' bo ni/ /drug pa sems kyi sprul pa ste/ /dag pa chos kyi sprul pa ni/ /phag mo'i gzugs su bstan pa'o/ /shrī yig gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru yig bkod pa dang bral ba/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /rang gi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po/ nas/ nyi ma'i 'od can no/ / dmigs pa gsal na lus dkyil 'khor gyi lha zhe brgyad gsal gdab/

mi gsal na mos pa tsam gyis bya ste/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su/ pu dza o a go ra de mā/ kā o ṭi ko ka la ka hi/ pre gri so su na si ma ku zhes so/ /rjes su sum+bha lan gnyis kyis phyogs bcing ngo*/ /gnyis pa zhing sbyong gi rnal 'byor ni/ yab kyi rkang brgyad brjod / bdag dang snang ba'i 'khor lo thams cad 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku'i rang bzhin/ brjod pa dang grags pa'i sgra thams cad gsung gi rang bzhin/ dran rig rnam rtog thams cad thugs bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du rnam par dag go / de nas dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo bar bya ste/ bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci spyad pas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /bla med rdo rje theg pa'i snod gyur te/ /kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid gyur cig /skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du/ /blo ldan rig bzang nga rgyal med pa dang*/ /snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus brtan/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i dam tshig la gnas shog /rdo rje dril bu la sogs rtag tu 'chang*/ /zab cing rgya che'i chos don rtogs pa dang*/ /go ku shu kra la sogs rtag bzang zhing*/ /mthar thug bde chen sgrub pa'i skal ldan shog /bde gshegs spyan sngar gnas gsum mkha' 'gro yi/ /dam bcas srung shing dngos grub mchog stsol bar/ /thugs dam bcas shing rtag srung dngos grub ni/ /rnam gsum tshe 'di nyid la thob par shog /lha mo tshad ma sogs dang*/ srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni rjes chags dul bar ldan/ /'od zer sngon po stong ldan nyi ma brgya stong ldan/ /rnam mang sku dang cha lugs rjes chags sems dpar ldan/ /he ru ka dpal sngags pa lhan cig gar byed shog / ces pa la sogs pa'o/ /rnal 'byor lhag ma rnams las/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ gong nang mchod kyi skabs dang 'dra ba las/ phud phul ba'i rjes su/ oṃ sa ma ya shud+dha sarba dharma sa mā ya shud+dho3haṃ/

zhes nga rgyal bzung ba ni 'dir khyad par ro/ /spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor gyi skabs su g.yon pa'i kun spyod do/ /gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ thun tha ma la'am/ thun re re zhing ngam/ nam phyed kyi dus na bya ste/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma sha chang sogs dang ldan par bshams/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra ra dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pas bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūṃ las byung ba'i mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ a las byung ba'i thod pa dum bu gsum pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ de'i nang gi shar du oṃ dkar po las dri chen oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ byang du khaṃ ljang khu las sha chen gyi dwangs ma khaṃ gis mtshan pa/ nub tu aṃ dmar po las byang chub kyi sems aṃ gis mtshan pa/ lhor trāṃ ser po las rak+ta trāṃ gis mtshan pa/ dbus su hūṃ sngon po las dri chu hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ mer laṃ dkar po las ba glang gi sha laṃ gis mtshan pa/ bden bral du māṃ sngon po las khyi'i sha māṃ gis mtshan pa/ rlung du baṃ dmar po las glang po'i sha baṃ gis mtshan pa/ dbang ldan du tāṃ ljang khu las rta'i sha tāṃ gis mtshan pa/ dbus su bāṃ dmar po las sha chen bāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ rlung g.yos me 'bar bas rdzas bcu yi ge dang bcas pa zhu ba nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog ltar dmar ser gsal la dngas par gyur pa'i steng thad du/ hūṃ yig las byung ba'i kha ṭ+waṃ ga dkar po byang chub kyi sems bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can/ mgo bo thur du blta ba/

de las bdud rtsi dkar po babs te/ der ltung bas g.yon bskor du lan gsum dkrugs shing zhu bas dngul chu mdog can shin tu bsil ba'i bdud rtsir gyur/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dz+nya nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa rnams kha dog sna tshogs pa yongs su gyur pa las/ oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po hūṃ sngon po rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ de las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha dang bcas pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phros/ rgya mtsho la sogs pa na gnas pa'i bdud rtsi dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dpa' mo thams cad kyi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi bkug cing*/ 'gro ba rnams 'khor lo gsum gyi lhar byas pa rnams spyan drangs/ snyoms 'jug gi bde bas zhu/ de thams cad yig 'bru gsum la thim/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ yang rim pa ltar bdud rtsir zhu ba gtor ma la thim pas/ kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/

lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab pa'o/ / rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa skad cig gis grub par gyur/ de nas rkang pa mnan cing gyen du blta/ zhes pa'i 'dug tshul dang*/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas te/ phaiṃ/ ces brjod/ rang gi snying gis hūṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis/ ye shes sems dpa' dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor/ phyi rol phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba sogs srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ yo ga shud+dha= lan gcig sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya ho/ lan gsum/ mchod yon dang zhabs bsil phul/ lag pa g.yon du ā li las zla ba/ g.yas su kā li las nyi ma/ dbus su hūṃ zla nyi hūṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje thal mor gyur/ gtor snod lag gis blangs par mos la/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*/ /des brjod gsung yang mchog tu tshad ma ste/ /bden pa de yi lha mo de dag gis/ /bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /lha rnams gtor ma gsol ba la thugs dges pa dang ldan pa las/ ye shes kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus drangs te gtor ma gsol bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a ral+li ho/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dri sh+ya hoḥ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes lan bdun gyi phul gong bzhin/ ar+ghaṃ= nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pa chags dang kun rtog chags pa bcoms/ khyod kyis dngos kun rang bzhin nam mkha' dang ni 'drar gzigs kyang*/ /mgon po shin tu lci ba'i thugs rje'i chu rgyas sems la ni/ /mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyi bdag la rjes rtser mdzad du gsol/ / zhes gsol ba btabs so/

/'jig rten pa rnams la phul bar mos te/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa/ bhu ta pre ta pi shā tsa/ un+ma da a pa sma ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra ya ts+tshan+tu/ ya thai waṃ/ yaṃ thaiṣ+taṃ/ bhu dza tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kā ra ta yā/ sat+su khaṃ/ bi shud+dha ya/ sa ha yi ka bha wān+tu/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ gong bzhin mchod/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /klu yi tshogs= gnod sbyin= srin po'i= 'byung po'i= yi dwags= sha za'i= smyo byed= brjed byed= mkha' 'gro'i tshogs= ma mo'i= ma lus par ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyi mches pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' bsdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms/ /rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing*/ /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pas/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyugs dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /srung mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ / 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog

yig brgya bzla/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ yo ga shud+dho'i/ sngags brgya bya/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs/ dkyil 'khor dang dkyil 'khor pa rang nyid la thim/ smon lam gdab/ bkra shis brjod do/ / 'di ni gtor chog logs su byed pa'i dbang du byas la dkyil 'khor ma bsdus par byed na/ bzlas pa'i mthar te lugs 'di ltar na gtor ma yang mchod pa'i rnal 'byor gyi khongs su 'du'o/ /de ltar na rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar/ zhes pa nas/ grub par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar spangs shing*/ ye shes sems dpa' dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor zhes pa'i tshab tu/ ye shes kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa/ zhes brjod pa ni khyad par ro/ /nyal ba dang ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rim pas bya zhing*/ gnyid sad ma thag pa dang nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la 'jug khar/ ngag byin gyis rlabs pa 'di bsgoms par bya ste/ tshig gi brjod pa thams cad la ā l̥ kā l̥'i de kho na nyid kyis rgyas btab ste/ oṃ h+ye hi/ mahā bī ra shud+dha wakya s+ya de sha ka shu bya ta ni waṃ tsa/ sriṣ+tī sa da ha ra swā yaṃ bhu wa/ zhes pa'am/ de'i bod skad/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon dpa' bo che/ /dag pa'i ngag ni ston pa po/ / stong nyid ye shes 'di kho na/ /spros dang bsdud pa rang byung ba'o/ /zhes so/ /oṃ ā nas ha k+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum brjod nas 'od gsal du 'jug pa dang*/ 'od gsal du ldang ba'i dmigs pa bya/ rnal 'byor gzhan rnams ni sgrub thabs 'di'i don dang lhan cig tu 'chad par 'dod do/ /'dir nyer mkho 'phreng ba byin rlabs ni/ rgyas pa sam bhu ṭi dang gdan bzhi dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa rnams las bshad pa ltar ram/ bsdu na bsangs sbyangs sngon du 'gro bas/ hrīḥlas pad+ma gar dang dbang yum dang bcas pa 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can du bskyed/

gnas gsum gyi byin gyis rlabs/ ye shes pa bcugarigs bdag yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur/ chu gnyis dang nyer spyod kyis mchod/ rdo rje mi 'chi 'dod chags che sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ swāhā hu pad+ma ni rte shwa ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes sam/ a ro lika brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ de zhu ba las 'phreng ba'i rnam par bsam pa'o// //'dir smras pa/ dpal ldan sdom pa'i rgyud rgyal rgya mtsho 'dra/ /dngos grub mtha' yas nor bu'i tshogs kyis bltams/ /thabs dang shes rab rlabs 'phreng g.yo ba can/ /byis blos rkyal gyis ji ltar rgal bar nus/ /de slad btang snyoms sten par rigs na yang*/ /lam mchog 'di la mos pa'-i gzhan dbang gyur/ /'bras mchog ma thob gyur kyang 'dir stsol ba/ /dge bas rab tu rtsom pa don mchog ldan/ /'di cis legs sam nyes par gyur kyang sla/ /dam pa'i zhal lung dpang por byas te bkod/ /bdag nyid nyams su blang ba'i don slad dang*/ /skal mnyam re re la yang phan pa srid/ /'di las dge ba gang thob pas/ /srid lam 'khyam pa'i sems can kun/ /bde chen dam pa'i gnas mchog la/ /myur ba nyid du 'khod par shog /ces pa dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs/ /bde ba chen po'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba chen po slob dpon lū yi pa'i bzhed gzhung ltar sbyar ba 'di yang*/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo bzhi bcu zhe gcig pa la nags rgyal gyi dben gnas su'o/ / ༈ 'dir lū yi pa la rtsa rkyang gi lugs su 'dod pa dang*/ 'grel pa lugs gnyis yod pa las/ 'dir phyi ma yin/ lugs 'di la mar pa do pa dang pu rangs pa dang*/ rwa lo'i lugs sogs yig rnying mang yang ngag 'don mi bde ba dang*/ bu ston man chad kyi yi ge phyi ma rnams ha cang tshig tshogs ches pa dang*/ rigs mthun rung gi gzhung thams cad nas mthun sdebs kyi kha bskang ba ha cang thal ba'i skyon yang cung zad snang bas/

'dir dag cing 'khyer bde bar bkod pa yin no/ /maṅga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs lū yi pa'i lugs bde chen 'jug ngogs bzhugs/ -PAGE 198--PAGE 199--PAGE 159-
